title: Patriots 53-man roster projection 1.0: Will New England really stick with 7 receivers?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: New England Patriots face wide receiver and offensive line decisions as they prepare to cut roster to 53 players by Aug. 30.
Patriots could retain 7 receivers, including Kayshon Boutte, amid trade considerations for draft capital during NFL roster cuts.
Quarterbacks Drake Maye, Tommy DeVito, and Behren Morton are set to remain, with Morton potentially developing as backup.

title: Adley Rutschman could make his Red Sox debut in coming days
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Catcher Adley Rutschman, traded to the Red Sox on August 3, is set to join the team in Toronto.
Injured since July with wrist inflammation, Rutschman played two rehab games with Triple-A Worcester last weekend.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy anticipates Rutschman's potential debut later this week against the Blue Jays.

title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Governor Maura Healey signed a bill permitting state takeover of Norwood Hospital via eminent domain.
The law allows transfer of the 11-acre property to a nonprofit to complete the stalled hospital construction.
Norwood Hospital has been vacant since floods in 2020; Steward Health Care faced bankruptcy in October 2024.

title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A building collapse at 265 Dwight St. Ext. in Springfield displaced 45 residents after severe thunderstorms.
Mayor Domenic J. Sarno declared a state of emergency due to power outages and downed trees from the storm.
The Red Cross and additional crews from Connecticut are aiding displaced residents and restoring power.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, acknowledging his Patriots and Colts careers during his speech.
Vinatieri humorously mentioned Bill Belichick's current position at UNC and the Patriots' Deflategate controversy.
His speech also praised the New England Patriots fanbase and lauded former teammate Tom Brady's impact on football.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old bicyclist was struck by a vehicle and killed in Williamstown, Massachusetts, on Friday.
The collision occurred at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road; the child was wearing a helmet.
No arrests or charges have been made; the driver was not impaired by drugs or alcohol.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials advise keeping pets out of Ames Pond after a dog's death, possibly linked to an algae bloom.
Algae blooms, suspected in the incident, can cause illnesses in humans and be fatal to animals, officials warned.
Weekly tests of Ames Pond show no E. Coli issues, but cyanobacterial algae blooms are being investigated.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: James Lamoureux, a former NH State Trooper, was decertified for misleading police about tracking devices on vehicles.
Lamoureux pleaded guilty to making false reports, receiving a suspended six-month prison sentence, deferred for two years.
He resigned from the police force, will be placed on the decertified officers list, and can't work in law enforcement again.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to Grace Chapel for a report of a man with a gun, causing a lockdown.
The individual was found polishing a powder horn, a musket-era item, and was not a threat.
Heavy police presence ensued, closing parts of Worthen Road; public reassured there was no danger.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will sustain performance to qualify for 2026 playoffs despite recent success.
Red Sox have 96% playoff probability, holding second A.L. wild-card spot with a 64-52 record.
FanGraphs gives Red Sox 83.4% odds for wild-card and 12.6% for A.L. East title, after recent win streaks.
